scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/mobile test -- --ci
scripts.build: npm run build -w @form/api && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build:web
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
